evidence: A traveler used the site in Tirana, learned neighborhood history, discovered museums and buildings to visit, and called it a useful resource.

evidence_sources.author: johnny_lol
evidence_sources.excerpt: I used this during my walk around around Tirana, Albania this morning where I'm traveling right now. I learned some interesting history about the neighborhood I'm staying in. Also discovered some museums and buildings nearby that I'd like to check out now. When I visit a new city I usually spend time poking around Google Maps to discover points of interest nearby, but this will be another useful resource. Thanks!

source_story_title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
